notes: MLXUI-authored (issue #8, MC4-8) -- catflow-mlx has no manifest for this model, so this was written in the shape of bge-m3.json. It has no checksum field, as the other MLXUI-authored manifests (the Gemma 4 pair, MiMo, Qwen3.8, Parakeet, Qwen3-ASR) have none: there is no catflow source manifest to inherit one from and the field is documentary. settings is empty on purpose: this version takes text only in workflows (image Embed needs a `list(text)` -> `list(text) | list(image)` language change, filed upstream and out of scope), applies no per-task instruction and offers no dimension choice (issue decisions 3, 7, 11). resources.disk_gb is browser.json's downloadSizeGB (1.8) and resources.ram_gb is its ramGB 2.7, the provisional 1.5x-weights estimate -- MC4-7 measures the peak and the maintainers set the final figure (decision 9; no `.embedding` row is added). Verified against mlx-community/Qwen3-VL-Embedding-2B-4bit revision c713a965783416b9467b419f2d14ca6445847455 (4-bit MLX, Apache-2.0; the official Qwen/Qwen3-VL-Embedding-2B is the parity reference only).
